title: Words for an erase the record write did not take, after the chat step ran: the web says nothing of the chat, the iPhone gives the wrong reason
evidence: After S57 an erase whose cloud and device writes both fail answers { success: false } with no reason, after its chat step (and on the web the reminders teardown) has run. Web: useErase.ts says ERASE_FAILED 'Failed to delete data. Please try again.' (erase-copy.ts:79), true for the record but silent on a chat history that may already be deleted (deleteUserData returns chatErased). iPhone: DataEraser.swift:190-197 says EraseText.failed('', ...) 'Your record was not erased. Your chat history was deleted.' (true, with a doubled space from the empty reason), or with no chat step landed EraseText.unreachable: '<cloud> could not be reached, so nothing was deleted. An erase must read the record it erases. Try again once you are online.' The read worked here and the write failed, so the middle sentence is wrong. Drafted for Brad's yes. Web, chat deleted: 'Your health record was not deleted: it could not be saved. Your chat history was deleted. Please try again.' Web, chat not deleted: keep ERASE_FAILED. iPhone, no chat step landed: 'Nothing was deleted: the erase could not be saved in <cloud> or on this iPhone. Try again once you are online.' iPhone, chat step landed: 'Your record was not erased: the erase could not be saved in <cloud> or on this iPhone.' followed by the existing chat sentences. US-11 AC2c, AC3b; US-25 AC16
